mapper.select: SELECT u.account_id, u.user_id, u.site_id, (select sub.site_name from site_info sub where u.site_id = sub.site_id) as site_name, u.username, u.user_role, u.account_status, u.created_by, u.created_at, u.created_ip, u.updated_by, u.updated_at, u.updated_ip FROM user_account u WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT u.account_id, u.user_id, u.site_id, u.user_role, u.password_hash, u.password_changed_at, u.password_reset_required FROM user_account u WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT l.login_id, l.user_id, l.password_error_count, l.created_by, l.created_at, l.created_ip, l.updated_by, l.updated_at, l.updated_ip FROM user_login_attempt l WHERE l.login_id = #{loginId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_login_attempt ( login_id, user_id, password_error_count, created_by, created_ip, updated_by, updated_ip ) VALUES ( #{loginId}, #{userId}, 0, 'ANONYMOUS', /* login 시도 시에는 user_id 식별불가 */ #{createdIp}, 'ANONYMOUS', /* login 시도 시에는 user_id 식별불가 */ #{updatedIp} )

INSERT INTO user_account ( user_id, username, password_hash, user_role, created_by, created_ip, updated_by, updated_ip ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{userRole}, #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp} )
mapper.select: SELECT k.account_id, a.user_id FROM user_api_key k JOIN user_account a ON k.account_id = a.account_id WHERE api_key = #{apiKey} AND valid_until >= current_timestamp AND enabled = true AND expired_at is null
